scope: Observation of existing capture consistency and integration-retained fence obligations only; no acquisition/release, actual backend, capture dispatch or restore safety.
persistence: Only ConsistencyRequirementRecord has strict v1 Serde admission. All fresh request/result/target/fence/view types are ephemeral without Serde/default or persisted authority flags.

requirement.plan_intent: Exact full original plan intent binds all context/inventory/selection/graph/requests/original allowances
requirement.admission: Requires exact retained operation-plan.json under layout exclusion; no-replace create and exact expected requirement digest/plan read. Missing evidence never downgrades/recreates original requirement.
requirement.authority: Declaration only; no fresh fence, completion, spending or dispatch permission

request.operation_sequence: Derives one original binding; payload/context/original allowances bind through full plan intent. Does not interpret/validate capture wire bytes or dispatch.
request.requirement: Must match exact original plan; integration supplies originally admitted requirement, not a weaker replacement
request.challenge: Integration-owned fresh unpredictable unique challenge; digest equality alone proves no freshness
request.expected_fence: PerCanister requires None. ApplicationCoordinated requires exact retained fence identity AND original membership revision recovered by its durable integration obligation owner. Constructor does not inspect retention or acquire/release/recover custody.

max_remote_observations.meaning: Descriptive invocation ceiling only, not a reservation/preflight allowance or paid-call permit

observation.inventory: Complete actually observed canonical inventory including unselected parent metadata
observation.targets: Nonempty 1..1024 normalized sorted unique inventory-backed physical targets, each with actual Running/Stopping/Stopped state and required opaque integration-qualified stopped/drained evidence. Policy requires exact original selected set and every target Stopped.
observation.membership_revision: Actually observed optional revision; coordinated evidence requires original retained revision
observation.consistency: PerCanister or ApplicationCoordinated with explicit current Active/Inactive state, exact identity, membership revision and required whole-selection writes/membership/timers/external_work/drained_work evidence digests. Unknown custody fails at provider boundary.
observation.evidence: Opaque integration-qualified current observation evidence; not a signature or authority flag
observation.remote_observations: Actual calls, each requiring separate approved prior accounting

admission: Every target actually Stopped with qualified drained-work evidence
Exact original guarantee; no automatic upgrade/downgrade
Coordinated fence exact retained identity, currently Active, actual revision and fence revision both equal original retained revision

provider_errors.Unavailable: No qualified provider; reject before effects
provider_errors.Unsupported: Cannot satisfy original guarantee; reject before effects
provider_errors.Indeterminate: Uncertain observations/reply/accounting/custody; retain spent allowance/evidence and fence obligations, stop without retry/reset/release

encoding: 64 canonical lowercase ASCII original requirement-digest bytes
If Some: 64 ASCII fence identity bytes followed by 64 ASCII original membership-revision bytes

integration_obligations: Qualify actual authenticated context/inventory/selection and stopped/drained state, challenge freshness and coherent custody; echoed labels/old receipts/unqualified query responses cannot substitute
Retain original requirement under exact expected digest; derive no weaker guarantee from absent or edited evidence
Retain/recover exact original application fence identity AND membership revision through the durable obligation owner; observe current Active custody

Prove whole-unit application write/membership/timer/external-work fencing and drained work continuously across capture/interruption; matching IDs/revisions before/after or sequential stops alone are insufficient
Acquire/release fence effects need independent reviewed exact intent, accounting, uncertain-effect reconciliation and terminal admission; this port performs neither
Failure/timeout/process death/drop cannot release retained obligations or replenish allowance
Each paid observation and capture needs its own prior approved accounting/custody; descriptive ceiling grants no calls
Capture wire codecs, permissions, backend snapshot/extent/completion and same-release restore/external-payment settlement remain separately qualified
Terminal replay invokes no provider; fresh live verification remains distinct
qualified_scope: Native declaration/persistence/port/policy and retained spent-journal/obligation fixture recovery only; no actual IC lifecycle/application fence or B1/B2 completion.
